project.name: MAISON KRIZSAN
project.site_type: Homepage + continuous Work + shareable Commission Portfolio + dedicated enquiry alternative
project.status: implemented and tested locally; live release and publication approvals outstanding

audience.primary_persona: Creative, marketing and property decision-makers at hotels, private residences, destinations
required_beliefs: Maison works in architecture, hospitality, residential and place-based imagery
The studio offers photography, film, visual direction

conversion.delivery: Resend, requires verified RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM secrets
conversion.fallback: On unconfirmed delivery, offer prefilled mailto link without a false success message

creative_direction.name: The House of Place, edited
creative_direction.principle: An authoritative photograph wins attention; unambiguous copy confirms services; composition and pace embody discernment.
creative_direction.reference: Colville-Walker Aman page-by-page art direction and property specificity, not copied Aman design.

home_hero.why: Emotive sunbeams and grand dome, strongest architectural moment from Batch 1 that survives desktop/mobile crop
home_hero.playback: muted, on visibility, intersection-gated; reduced-motion and save-data use still photo

work_cover.why: Symmetrical arched windows with an extraordinary chandelier; Batch 1 photographic jewel with a clear architectural focal point at 1440 and 390

creative_direction.motion: no custom scroll; subtle CSS; reduced motion safe

content.copy_policy: Clear commercial context without fake client claims or unsupported outcome statistics
content.filmmaking_proof: No verifiable video file in this provided image-only library; portfolio work shows photos
content.commercial_positioning: Photography and film that make people want to be there. Hospitality, architectural and destination imagery made for property marketing needs.
content.supported_deliverables: Photography, property films/motion, visual direction. No explicit results, clients, lead counts, duration or price claims.

homepage_sections: Founder-led studio and independent photography studies
Two buyer-facing engagement formats and shareable commission portfolio

work_page.commission_invitation: Direct after cover and inside first photographic edit; final enquiry remains

additional_checks: CSS ViewTimeline movement measured during browser scrolling
selected visual renders on desktop and mobile

release_unknowns: Hero motion is animated from one photograph; not proof of a commissioned property film.
Live CDN content type and response for each image size; previous reports of HTML returned for WebP.
Cloudflare production form deployment and Resend key configuration

copy_update.strategy: Beautiful photographs establish taste; explicit service copy establishes what can be commissioned. No abstract slogan before the offer is understood.
copy_update.studio_heading: Photography & film. Made for exceptional places.
copy_update.footer: Full-width Maison Krizsan wordmark, stacked on mobile; utility links and information pages.
copy_update.inquiry_path: Services → scope and process → email prefilled with project fields
copy_update.without_fabrication: No named client, paid commission, or result claims without permission and evidence

legal_pages.privacy: Transparent operational notice, review against actual hosting/email/analytics setup before publication
legal_pages.terms: Portfolio usage and enquiries; no implied binding commission
legal_pages.accessibility: Commitment and feedback contact; not a certification

motion.method: CSS native ViewTimeline on a few full-width photographic frames, gentle reveal on a few paired images; static fallback

commission_portfolio.purpose: Help a hotel owner, marketing director or approving team understand work, scope, next step
commission_portfolio.provenance: User-provided independent photo archive only; no client logos, paid commission claims, impact stats, testimonials or invented film proof
commission_portfolio.scope_policy: Written scope including usage, fees, schedule and final deliverables before work begins

conversion_decision: Homepage form is primary; two concise commission types live inside existing process section; Work retains direct /enquire
